# Local reading components

Downloaded from the official npm registry with install scripts disabled.
Only browser distribution files and KaTeX fonts are bundled; runtime uses no CDN.

- marked 18.0.14 — Markdown parser; see marked-LICENSE.
- DOMPurify 3.4.16 — sanitize parsed Markdown before display; see dompurify-LICENSE.
- KaTeX 0.19.0 — formula rendering with trust disabled; see katex-LICENSE.

Corresponding source packages: https://www.npmjs.com/package/marked,
https://www.npmjs.com/package/dompurify, https://www.npmjs.com/package/katex.
